text: This report presents the City of Toronto's (City) Consolidated Financial Statements (Consolidated Statements), the Sinking Funds Financial Statements and the Trust Funds Financial Statements for the year ended December 31, 2025. All City financial statements are prepared in accordance with Public Sector Accounting Standards established by the Public Sector Accounting Board of the Chartered Professional Accountants of Canada. The City's external auditors, KPMG LLP, issued unqualified (clean) audit opinions for all of the City's 2025 Statements.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the 2025 Consolidated Financial Statements in Appendix B to the report (June 24, 2026) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and the Controller and Chief Accountant. 2. City Council approve the 2025 Sinking Funds Financial Statements in Appendix C to the report (June 24, 2026) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and the Controller and Chief Accountant. 3. City Council approve the 2025 Trust Funds Financial Statements in Appendix D to the report (June 24, 2026) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and the Controller and Chief Accountant.
